evals.name: concurrency-contract-assurance
evals.prompt: 独立检查一个包含取消、deadline 和 execution exit 语义的 PR。请冻结可执行 contract，使用 fresh context 生成候选测试，在真实实现上分类验证结果，并给出反向验证和未决契约缺口。
evals.expected_output: A report with stable contract IDs, isolated candidate tests, explicit result classifications, reverse-verification status, and contract gaps.
assertions: Does not treat an unresolved timeout or partial PIT run as passing, while allowing a fully evidenced and approved mutation exception to pass the gate without changing the raw status
Separates implementation defects from test assumptions and missing oracle details
Records the same run directory and adapter inputs across phases

evals.name: documentation-only-change
evals.prompt: 对一个只修改用户文档的 PR 做独立 assurance。请提取文档承诺，说明哪些 Java 测试、mutation testing 和反向验证不适用，并保留可审计的跳过原因。
evals.expected_output: A contract and report that keep documentation evidence while marking inapplicable executable phases as SKIPPED with reasons.
assertions: Does not invent production tests for a documentation-only diff
Reports skipped phases explicitly with reasons

evals.name: missing-host-adapter
evals.prompt: 在一个没有提供构建命令和 mutation 策略的陌生 polyglot 仓库中运行独立 assurance。请说明哪些输入缺失，并停止在可复现的 BLOCKED 或 INCONCLUSIVE 状态，不要猜测 Maven、Gradle 或 PIT 命令。
evals.expected_output: A blocked or inconclusive report naming missing adapter inputs and avoiding guessed ecosystem commands.
assertions: Does not infer a build ecosystem from the repository name

evals.name: accepted-mutation-liveness-exception
evals.prompt: PIT 报告中某个变异体稳定触发 TIMED_OUT，已有完整 XML、进程心跳、未变异测试通过记录和源码级活性证明，并得到维护者批准。请生成 assurance 报告和 run manifest。
evals.expected_output: A report that keeps TIMED_OUT as the raw status, records EXPECTED_MUTATION_LIVENESS as an accepted exception, and reports the normalized PIT gate as pass with accepted exceptions.
assertions: Preserves TIMED_OUT in raw mutation evidence
Requires evidence paths and approver for the accepted exception
Reports unresolved or weakly evidenced timeouts as inconclusive
